subject: Copy record Vector and Sequence candidate admission and execution
claim: The recorded source admits ordinary and materialized generic Copy record collection elements as candidate WVB 1.42. Supplied products on Windows and Debian passed seven deterministic source programs, seven malformed-WVB cases, five source rejections, and three logical bounds traps per host. The seven emitted record modules and instruction counts agree across hosts. Growth preserves live nested record handles without a preparatory helper call, append refusal returns the original record, frozen aliases retain records, and 900 iterations exercise reclamation. Existing borrowed-Vector, owned-payload/tracing, and Vector/Sequence lifetime selections also passed on both hosts.

limitations: This is supplied-product paired-host development evidence. The analyzer, emitter, verifier, and runner WVB were constructed on Windows and separately packaged for Windows and Debian; independent Linux compiler reconstruction and whole-product qualification were not run.

Construction, append, and growth retain Main-owned budget execution; source freezing retains its single-block validation restriction. Helper budget threading, the maintained typed Package-Lock directory, shared/owned record elements, mutable indexing and other collection APIs remain open.

Source empty-record declarations remain rejected. Synthetic runtime probes cover the existing zero-field sentinel representation, exact nominal identity, field counts, malformed directories, stale storage and live-root tracing.

Native lowering of the candidate operations, browser and OS execution, installed promotion, full WebAssembly engine checks, release signing and publication were not performed. The broad 4,455-second automatically routed plan was narrowed to causal selections.

The first lifetime harness attempt stopped before execution because its output directory was absent. That selection was rerun after creating the directory; other passing selections were retained. Earlier diagnostic failures and intermediate products are not passing final evidence.

After functional verification, only the unselected combined-selector report was corrected from 517 total/20 record groups to 519 total/22 record groups. The selected-case implementations did not change; their tested owner snapshot is retained as a local artifact.

Products, construction caches and raw logs are local development artifacts. Recorded owner durations include compilation and execution with parallel contention. No peak-memory measurement was collected.
